target: three unmergeable rank11 tiles, fixed default spawn model
selection: Strictly more training wins replaces incumbent; start baseline, order as rounds; ties retain incumbent. Always freeze best non-baseline candidate for holdout, even if it failed to beat baseline; ties use declared order. No selection on holdout.
plateau: After first round, two successive refinement rounds without strictly increasing incumbent wins. If not reached, preregister additional training-only refinements before running them; never tune after holdout. Plateau is local to tested families/12 training seeds.
holdout_decision: One candidate only. Exact one-sided paired binomial p<=0.05 AND more holdout wins AND no limits supports offline improvement; otherwise no convincing improvement. No default/runtime adoption without separate 8/10s and phone evidence.
censoring: A limit invalidates selection/control, not counted as loss; increase limit symmetrically in a protocol amendment before comparison.
cost: Record nodes, clipping counts, depth_counts and wall time. Focus buys depth with additional CPU; no equal-budget efficiency claim.

hypotheses.progress: Cap-count reward changes earlier sacrifices/progress; cheap proxy previously tested at10000, not staged win-probability value; constant after two caps.
hypotheses.mobility: At exactly two caps bonus per legal leaf direction preserves workspace; four execute_move calls per affected leaf; can reward useless shuffling.
hypotheses.focus: Depth4 only at >=two caps and <=N empty cells; otherwise3. Can resolve imminent traps; extra CPU and can react too late.
